facebookText:
Planning a Toledo Bend trip this week? Here's a lake-level check and a couple of November patterns to ask about.

TWDB's November 12 reading at 6:15 a.m. puts the lake at 167.73 feet—about 4.3 feet below its 172-foot conservation pool. Data is provisional; check the current level and your chosen launch before going.

In his November outlook, published October 31 in Louisiana Sportsman, local guide Matthew Loetscher points to bass around grass and channel edges, using soft plastics or lipless crankbaits in 8–14 feet. For crappie, his seasonal pointers include bridges and timber in 15–30 feet, with live minnows or small jigs.

Those are seasonal pointers, not a same-day bite report. TPWD's regular weekly reports remain on hold.

Bass or crappie—which are you planning for?

Lake data: https://waterdatafortexas.org/reservoirs/individual/toledo-bend
Guide outlook: https://www.louisianasportsman.com/fishing/bass-fishing/toledo-bend-bass-will-relate-heavily-to-grass-and-channel-edges-this-month/
TPWD: https://tpwd.texas.gov/fishboat/fish/action/reptform2.php?lake=TOLEDO+BEND&yearcat=current&archive=latest&Submit=Go
